design engineers. And no wonder; for almost three-quar- ters of a century, BAUER the man has been inseparable from BAUER the com- pany. Heinz Bauer’s life with BAUER be­ gan shortly after the Second World War in 1946, when the newly founded com- pany began operations. After leaving school, he went straight into the company. Spells working with other companies in Switzerland and Great Britain enabled him to build a wealth of knowledge and experience. In 1976 his father Hans han- ded the family company to him, and four years later he also took the helm of the ISSUE 1/2020 Philipp Bayat, Dr. Monika Bayat, Heinz Bauer (l. to r.). the stored operating data in the B-CLOUD is available for later analysis and system performance optimization. If the condition of your compressor system changes, B-CLOUD or B-APP will notify you immediately – by email or via push notification straight to your smartphone. B-LINK Wi-Fi and 4G routers enable the wireless communication of the B-CONTROL MICRO with the B-CLOUD. They establish a reliable Wi-Fi or mobile network connection, allowing secure remote access to the compressor system. Intermediate pressure gauge Analog pressure gauges are installed at appropriate points of the compressor system and allow for easy monitoring of operating pressures. They support diagnostics and simplify maintenance work on the system. Separate intake buffer and condensate vessel In this closed system, the gas released during automatic condensate drainage is captured within the containers and fed directly back into the compression process. The system can also operate without a customer-supplied gas balloon. Its design is based on the combined container concept but consists of two separate vessels. The delivery scope also includes a suction solenoid valve and a compensation line for returning the collected gas to the intake side of the compressor. What is the VERTICUS (350 bar) used for? The VERTICUS (350 bar) is a stationary high-pressure breathing air compressor designed for continuous operation, ensuring a reliable supply of breathing air. The VERTICUS (350 bar) is designed for final pressures of up to 350 bar and can deliver up to 680 liters per minute, making it ideal for continuous filling operations in stationary applications. How maintenance-friendly is the VERTICUS (350 bar)? The VERTICUS (350 bar) is engineered for low-maintenance operation.
